connection.U3NoU2VydmVyQ29ubmVjdGlvbnM.s.source: Interval in seconds between SSH keepalive probes sent by the server. Helps detect dead connections over unreliable networks. Defaults to `60` when unset; set to `0` or a negative value to disable keepalive probes.
